t: You're looking at the London Marriott Hotel Canary Wharf, at 1 West India Quay on Hertsmere Road. It overlooks West India Dock North, and it takes its name from the Canary Wharf financial estate. Inside are 301 rooms and 47 serviced apartments, and it's run by Marriott. The hotel was once owned by John Christodoulou, a Monaco-based British-Cypriot property developer. His company, Yianis Group, holds homes, hotels, shops and leisure properties across the UK and Europe.
